usdRate.sourceName: Narodowy Bank Polski, average exchange rate table A (USD)
usdRate.note: PLN 3.9251 per US dollar on 30 October 2026 (table 212/A/NBP/2026); World Bank 2025 average 3.76.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistics Poland (GUS), flash estimate of the consumer price index in October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Consumer prices were 3.5% higher than in October 2025 (flash estimate released 30 October 2026; -0.4% on the month). World Bank 2025 average 3.8%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: NBP inflation target 2.5% +/- 1 point; Polish HICP 2021-2025 average 7.3% (ECB ICP)
inflation_projection.note: The NBP targets 2.5% but inflation has run above the target for most of the last five years (13.2% in 2022) and is 3.5% now, so planning uses 3.5%, at the top of the tolerance band.

policy_rate.sourceName: Narodowy Bank Polski, NBP base rates (reference rate)
policy_rate.note: Reference rate 3.75% in force since 5 March 2026 (lombard 4.25%, deposit 3.25%); the NBP rates feed still showed it unchanged at end-October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by NBP): Polish banks, overnight zloty deposits from households
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight (current and savings) zloty deposits was 0.48% in August 2026 (0.48% in July). Promotional savings accounts pay more for new money.

fdr_3m_rate.note: NBP and the ECB publish household term deposits up to 1 year as one bucket (2.94% in August 2026); no separate 3-month average was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by NBP): household zloty deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year, new business
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (3.00% in July 2026); 1-2 year deposits paid 1.96% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published average rate was found for Poland.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by NBP): household zloty deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year, new business
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No all-maturity average is published for Poland in the ECB dataset; deposits up to 1 year make up nearly all new household term deposits, so their weighted average (2.94%, August 2026) is used. The World Bank has no FR.INR.DPST figure for Poland.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Polish retail treasury savings bonds: 4-year indexed bonds COI1030
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: 4-year COI series sold 1-31 October 2026: 4.75% in year 1, then CPI + 1.50% (interest paid yearly). Same month: 6-year ROS 5.00% (family bond), 10-year EDO 5.35%, 3-year fixed TOS 4.40%, 1-year ROR 4.00%.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No current 3-month treasury bill yield was found; the Ministry of Finance funds itself mainly with bonds and treasury bills are not sold to individuals. The retail 3-month OTS savings bond paid a fixed 2.00% in October 2026 (obligacjeskarbowe.pl).

tbond_5y_rate.note: No 5-year Polish government bond yield could be read from an official or reachable secondary page on 31 October 2026.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Poland 10-year government bond yield (secondary source)
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year yield 6.38% on 30 October 2026; the ECB long-term convergence yield for Poland was 6.23% in September 2026 (ECB IRS dataset). Secondary source because the Ministry of Finance and NBP pages did not load.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Poland income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Flat 19% tax on interest from savings and deposits, withheld by the bank (page reviewed 11 August 2026). Interest inside IKE/IKZE retirement accounts can be tax-free.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Poland income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on retail treasury savings bonds is taxed at the same flat 19% as other interest, unless the bonds are held in an IKE or IKZE retirement account.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Bank Guarantee Fund (BFG), amount of the guarantee
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Zloty equivalent of EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank, converted at the NBP mid rate EUR 1 = PLN 4.3955 (30 October 2026). Up to EUR 200,000 for some temporary high balances (home sale, inheritance, insurance payouts).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by NBP): Polish banks, extended credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate: average 15.18% in August 2026. The Civil Code caps contractual interest at twice the sum of the NBP reference rate and 3.5 points, which is 14.5% with the reference rate at 3.75%; the average may include older contracts.

equity_return_low.sourceName: WIG index 157,676 on 30 Oct 2026, up 41% in a year (Trading Economics); after-tax 1-year deposit 2.4%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: Polish shares give back part of the 2025-26 rally and earn only a little more than after-tax savings bonds.

equity_return_base.sourceName: WIG total-return index (Trading Economics); after-tax 1-year retail bond ROR 3.24%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.75 points over the after-tax 1-year government savings bond, below the WIG's strong recent record because that run was driven by a few years of re-rating.

equity_return_high.sourceName: WIG total-return index (Trading Economics), roughly 12% a year since 2016
equity_return_high.note: High case: Polish and diversified equity funds keep close to the WIG's record of the last decade.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); zloty per dollar 3.93 (NBP, 30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stalls after the 2025-26 spike and the zloty stays firm against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); NBP 2.5% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, and the zloty loses about 1% a year against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in zloty terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.94% less 19% tax = 2.4% (ECB MIR)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax bank term deposits only.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: 1-year retail bond ROR 4.00% and 4-year COI 4.75% less 19% tax (Ministry of Finance)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: mostly retail treasury savings bonds after the 19% tax, allowing for lower rates later.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: 10-year retail bond EDO 5.35% less 19% tax = 4.3% (Ministry of Finance)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: long inflation-indexed retail treasury bonds at today's margins, or the same bonds held tax-free in an IKE account.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) publishes insurance market statistics, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover is sold in Poland, but no regulator or official premium table per sum insured was found; only individual company quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care is free under the National Health Fund (NFZ); no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is sold in Poland, but no published premium table per PLN 100,000 of cover from a regulator or public source was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 16.2% of current health expenditure in 2024 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Poland, health: 5.0% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose 5.0% in 2025, double general HICP inflation (2.5%), so planning uses 5%, 1.5 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Poland, education: 6.7% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose 6.7% in 2025, well above general inflation; planning uses 5.5%.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 75.5, women 82.7 (UN WPP estimate for 2026); World Bank 2024 figure 78.4.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 32.0 (2025, World Bank), 40.5 (2040) and 70.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/poland/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Poland (July 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: Statutory pension age is 65 for men and 60 for women, irrespective of date of birth, since 1 October 2017; the figure shown is the men's age.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Poland (July 2026)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants are insured in the general ZUS scheme, so the same pension ages apply (65 men, 60 women); uniformed services and some other groups have separate rules.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax deposits with some further rate cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 1-year retail treasury bond ROR 4.00% less 19% tax = 3.24% (Ministry of Finance)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept below the after-tax 1-year government savings bond rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: 4-year COI 4.75% and 10-year EDO 5.35% less 19% tax (Ministry of Finance)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: mostly inflation-indexed retail treasury bonds held to maturity.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 7% and half safe fixed income at about 3.2%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Equity high 10%; after-tax indexed retail bonds 4.3%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy, permanent allowance (zasiłek stały)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Maximum for a single person from 1 January 2025: 130% of the single-person income threshold minus own income, capped at PLN 1,229 a month (minimum PLN 100). Paid by the municipal social assistance centre to people unable to work because of age (pension age) or disability. Poland has no universal social pension.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy, permanent allowance (zasiłek stały); European Commission, Your social security rights in Poland (July 2026)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Adults unable to work because of age (pension age: 65 men, 60 women) whose income is below the social assistance threshold (PLN 1,010 a month for a single person, PLN 823 per person in a family).

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code gives a one-off retirement severance (odprawa emerytalna) of one month's pay on retiring, and severance on collective dismissal of 1-3 months' pay by length of service; neither is a days-per-year gratuity, and no source stating it was read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Poland (July 2026)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory notional-account pension run by ZUS: pension age 65 men and 60 women; the pension equals contributions plus initial capital divided by life expectancy, with a minimum pension of PLN 1,878.91 gross (from 1 March 2025). Pensions are adjusted each 1 March by CPI plus at least 20% of real wage growth, and are taxed as income.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product; regular saving is usually done through savings accounts or retail treasury bonds.

sanchayapatra_5y.localNameEn: Retail treasury savings bonds (4-year indexed, COI)
sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold monthly by the Ministry of Finance from PLN 100 per bond; year 1 fixed, later years CPI plus a margin. 1-, 2-, 3-, 6-, 10- and 12-year series also exist.

tbill_91d.note: Treasury bills are sold only at wholesale auctions; individuals can buy the 3-month retail OTS savings bond instead.

tbond_5y.note: Marketable treasury bonds trade on the exchange and through brokerage accounts.

equity_fund.note: Retail mutual funds and exchange-traded index funds are widely available; IKE and IKZE retirement accounts give tax relief.

gold.note: Buying physical investment gold is legal and VAT-exempt under EU rules.

centralBank.name: Narodowy Bank Polski (National Bank of Poland)

insuranceComplaints.name: Financial Ombudsman (Rzecznik Finansowy)
insuranceComplaints.note: Handles complaints and out-of-court disputes between customers and insurers or banks.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Permanent allowance (zasiłek stały), Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Policy
oldAgeAllowance.note: Means-tested social assistance paid by the municipal social assistance centre (OPS).
